Failed on retry 0, PASSED on retry 1 — spec.ok is true, so this is a flake and must be ABSENT from parseVisualReport's changed[]. Its retry-0 pixel count is deliberately enormous so a parser that reads results[0] instead of the highest retry is impossible to miss.

specs._synthetic: HAND-SYNTHESIZED. `test.fail()` marks a spec expected-to-fail: the JSON reporter emits spec.ok TRUE while results[0].status is 'failed' and every attachment of the failed toHaveScreenshot is present. This is the shape in which the `spec.ok !== false` guard is load-bearing - the flake above has a highest-retry result with NO -actual attachment (playwright.config.ts sets screenshot: 'off', so a passing retry attaches nothing), which makes the guard accidentally redundant there and lets a mutation removing it survive. Must be ABSENT from changed[] and counted as unchanged.
specs.title: synthetic / expected-failure-with-a-full-snapshot-diff
